displayTransport.method: text-anchored crescent presentation of the unchanged accepted liquid
displayTransport.wristFraming: independent Z-only photographic framing; original pitch, roll, height and local reservoir preserved
displayTransport.physicalInterpretation: Unchanged accepted physical heightfields with authored connector-only longitudinal stretching for text alignment. Displayed mesh volume is measured separately from the unchanged physical mass ledger; no height normalization or curved-route simulation was performed.

physics.model: reduced-order Newtonian gravity/lubrication thin-film finite-volume solver
physics.coupling: one-way prescribed analytic-reservoir discharge into a conservative gravity/lubrication film
physics.impact: Ballistic flight to the plate using relative exit velocity plus actual nozzle translation
assumptions: Reduced Newtonian low-Re gravity/lubrication model; no 3D jet inertia, sloshing, wetting hysteresis or capillary pressure.
Reservoir discharge, ballistic landing and Gaussian impact footprint are explicit approximations; sauce rheology is not measured.
Render-only contact-line smoothing is volume-normalised and is separate from the physical height evolution.
The cached physical solution and discharge timing are unchanged. The displayed crescent is an authored geometric transport, not a new simulation of liquid flowing along that curve.

Only the thin connectors are stretched longitudinally to align the four protected pools with text columns. Displayed mesh volume is independently measured and differs from the original physical mass ledger; no post-transport height or volume normalization is applied.

camera.focusMethod: fixed near-end focus; real Cycles aperture depth of field

photography.sourceTiers: Native 1920 detents; native 1280 motion explicitly upscaled for desktop
